title: College Graduates, Cap & Gown Procession - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A formal outdoor academic procession of college graduates walking down a paved pathway on an American university campus, stamped March 1966 on the margin. The students wear traditional dark graduation gowns and mortarboards with tassels as spectators and faculty in suits watch from the lawn. In the background stands a stately multi-story academic hall framed by mature trees, documenting a mid-1960s rite of passage during an era of growing campus activism and social change.
